_comment: Vendored caniemail build-time policy for Phase 86 CSS lint gate.
_source: Curated from https://www.caniemail.com/features/ for the Phase 86 locked client set.
_clients: Gmail web, new Outlook web (Microsoft 365), Apple Mail on macOS.
_license: caniemail data is MIT-licensed. See https://github.com/hteumeuleu/caniemail

rationale.display:flex: Not supported in Gmail web (strips unknown CSS), partially supported in Outlook web but unreliable for layout-critical flows.
rationale.display:grid: Not supported in Gmail web or Outlook web (Word-engine ignores it). Apple Mail macOS 15+ supports it but Gmail blocks it, so deny-list applies.
rationale.position: Outlook Word-engine desktop ignores position entirely. Gmail web strips position from inline styles. Use table layout instead.
rationale.background-image: Outlook Word-engine strips background-image from inline styles. Gmail web blocks external images by default. Use background-color only.
rationale.float: Unreliable in Outlook Word-engine. Use table-based layout instead.
rationale.style-block: Gmail strips <style> blocks. Outlook Word-engine partially processes them but the behavior is inconsistent. All CSS must be inline.
rationale.animation: Not supported in Outlook (any version) and stripped by Gmail web.
rationale.box-shadow: Stripped by Gmail web and Outlook Word-engine.
rationale.css-variables: CSS custom properties (var(--name)) not supported in Outlook or Gmail web.
